evidence_tier: REAL, analysis tier: recomputation from archived evidence-tier artifacts with bit-exact replay assertions (drift <= 1e-9); no new sweeps. Responds to critique defects D2, D3, D4 (NEXT_BLOCK.md, committed before this registration).
question: A1: is every arm the estimated arm, i.e. do the archived unweighted-arm cells (including tilt directions the collapse batteries never tilted) land on each environment's ARCHIVED collapse curve when their aligned error is computed at w_hat == 1? A2: does the below-1 pooled slope dissolve under a sign split? A3: is kappa computable per cell from calibration draws, retiring the constancy claim, and does a proper equivalence analysis replace the retracted indistinguishability language?

predictions.P-A1a: Of the replayed unweighted cells whose a falls inside the archived isotonic knot range, at least 90% satisfy |excess - iso(a)| <= max(3*SE, 0.0075). Defense of 90%: the identical tolerance passed 289/290 estimated cells, the unweighted arm is the same functional at w_hat == 1, and the batteries' gamma = 0 cells already anchored to the sweeps within about 1 SE; 90% leaves room for the sweeps' seven-level grids probing curve regions the batteries sampled thinly.
predictions.P-A1b: Extension cells (a beyond the archived knot range, judged against the linear extension through the end knot at the archived pooled slope) pass at >= 80% under the wider tolerance max(3*SE, 0.01). Defense: the placeholder showed the curve STEEPENS beyond the near-linear regime, so a linear extension should undershoot at the largest a; 80% prices that known convexity in.
predictions.P-A1c: The tilt-DIRECTION unification: of the 12 tilt-location cells (claims inconsistency + severity; moderation toxicity + sarcasm, the latter two per environment never tilted by its collapse battery), at least 10 pass their applicable test. If confirmed, the coordinate unifies across tilt direction and the three headline results are one finding.
predictions.P-A1d: Descriptive, no threshold: APE(level) tracks kappa_pooled * a_unw(level) per sweep level, showing headline 4 is a plug-in of headline 2.
predictions.P-A2a: The positive-branch through-origin slope exceeds the pooled slope in at least 4 of 5 environments.
predictions.P-A2b: The mean positive-branch slope across the five environments is at least 0.85. Defense: the pilot's near-origin slopes (1.11 to 1.19) were positive-branch-dominated; the pooled evidence-tier 0.74 to 0.96 should be substantially an artifact of averaging a sign-asymmetric curve.
predictions.P-A2c: The negative branch sits below the positive branch in at least 4 of 5 environments, with mean negative-branch slope in [0.5, 0.9] (the pilot's conservative-side compression was 0.76).
predictions.P-A3a: Through-origin OLS of measured kappa (excess / a) on kappa_pred (ratio of central-difference loss-curve slopes at lambda*, window h = 0.05) over all collapse cells passing the registered guards has slope in [0.8, 1.25]. Defense of the window: finite differences over plateaued curves and threshold-selection noise each contribute O(10%) bias; a coefficient outside 25% of 1 would mean the identity misses a first-order term.
predictions.P-A3b: kappa_pred (one regressor) explains the guarded cells better than the environment label (five group means): R2(kappa_pred) > R2(env label). If confirmed, the constancy claim is RETIRED and replaced by: kappa is computable per deployment from calibration data alone.
predictions.P-A3c: Statistics fix, run regardless of outcome: TOST equivalence on all ten pooled-slope pairs at margin 0.25 (defense: at the realistic evidence-tier range |a| <= 0.02, a slope difference of 0.25 moves predicted excess by at most 0.005 = delta_control, so 0.25 is the decision-relevant margin), with achieved power reported per pair. The 'statistically indistinguishable' language in the collapse-extension C3 verdict and findings F13 is retracted by amendment in favor of the TOST result, whatever it is. No prediction is made about how many pairs prove equivalent; the registered claim is only that failure-to-reject language goes away.

falsifiers.P-A1a/b: Systematic off-curve unweighted cells mean the collapse is estimator-specific and the unification claim dies; the off-cell pattern (which levels, which zone) localizes what the functional misses.
falsifiers.P-A1c: Tilt-location cells systematically off-curve mean the collapse is per-tilt-direction; the aligned-error claim is narrowed to within-direction and every cross-direction use of it is retracted.
falsifiers.P-A2: Mean positive-branch slope below 0.85 means the below-1 slopes are NOT an averaging artifact and discreteness attenuation (Block B2) carries the burden of explaining D4.
falsifiers.P-A3a: Regression slope outside [0.8, 1.25] means kappa as a local slope ratio is incomplete; the residual structure (by plateau coarseness, by sign) names the missing term and Block C's adversarial environment tests the repaired version.
falsifiers.P-A3b: R2(env) >= R2(kappa_pred) means the environment carries decay-relevant structure the local slope ratio does not capture; the constancy claim stays retired but is replaced by an open problem rather than a computable quantity.

decision_rule: Guards, all registered here: A3 regression restricted to cells with |a| >= 0.003 (below that, measured kappa is a ratio of noise) and mean estimated-weighting slope >= 0.02 (below that, kappa_pred is a division by near-zero); dropped counts reported. Finite-difference window h = 0.05 primary with {0.03, 0.08} sensitivity reported descriptively. Replays assert reproduction of the archived arm means at drift <= 1e-9 or abort. The archived isotonic fits are the A1 yardstick and are NOT refit.
notes: All inputs are archived evidence-tier artifacts; the only randomness is the deterministic replay of their own seeds. NEXT_BLOCK.md (committed 56b451f, before this registration) is the block's source. Block B and C registrations will cite A3 outputs and may not be written until A verdicts are filed.

verdicts.runs: artifacts/blockA_e58d1bc4b8627b0d; all replay drift assertions passed at 1e-9
verdicts.P-A1a: CONFIRMED at the wire: 38 of 42 in-range cells on-curve (90.5%, threshold 90%).
verdicts.P-A1b: MISS, verbatim: extension cells 3 of 5 (60%, threshold 80%); both failures ABOVE the linear extension (underpriced convexity).
verdicts.P-A1c: MISS, verbatim: 9 of 12 tilt-location cells (threshold 10), cross-direction 3 of 6. The registered per-direction falsifier is NOT what the data show: the failure pattern is per-DISTANCE (claims severity level 1 on-curve, levels 2-3 far above; every off cell in all of A1 lies ABOVE its prediction, none below). Diagnosis: a is evaluated at the oracle threshold lambda*, and when the evaluated arm's threshold sits far from lambda* (severity tilts push oracle deferral to 0.25-0.31 while unweighted stays at source levels), a(lambda*) SATURATES while realized excess keeps growing (compliance sweep: a flat at 0.017 while excess climbs 0.031 to 0.038). The unification claim narrows along the threshold-distance axis, not the direction axis.

P-A1d.summary: Descriptive as registered: APE tracks kappa_pooled * a_unw tightly in correlation but outruns it exactly at the saturation boundary; APE forecasts the risk integral directly and does not saturate, which is now the measured reason it beat the identity at large shift.

verdicts.P-A2a: MISS, INVERTED: positive-branch slope below pooled in all five environments (0/5 vs predicted 4/5).
verdicts.P-A2b: CONFIRMED numerically (mean positive-branch slope 0.904) but for the wrong registered reason; see A2c.
verdicts.P-A2c: MISS, INVERTED: the negative branch is STEEPER in all five environments (1.40 to 3.62 vs predicted 0.5 to 0.9). Joint diagnosis with A3, exploratory and labelled: the relation is AFFINE, excess = kappa * a + c_env, with fitted intercepts matching each environment's measured oracle plateau conservatism to the third decimal (claims -0.0040 vs -0.0042; tickets -0.0054 vs -0.0066; fraud -0.0031 vs -0.0036; moderation -0.0035 vs -0.0036; compliance -0.0124 vs -0.0127). Every through-origin fit in the project inherited this: positive branches depressed, negative inflated, the below-1 pooled range manufactured. D4 is resolved as fit-model misspecification, not physics.
verdicts.P-A3a: MISS: regression slope 0.702 +/- 0.095, outside [0.8, 1.25]; the y-variable inherits c/a contamination spanning +/- 1.5 among guarded cells.
verdicts.P-A3b: MISS, doubly: R2(kappa_pred) = -0.02 and R2(env label) = 0.001, both nil on the registered y-variable, exactly as the affine model predicts. EXPLORATORY corrected form (paired difference estimated minus oracle, through origin): per-environment R2 0.939 to 0.987 with slopes fraud 1.005, claims 1.249, moderation 1.361, tickets 1.499, compliance 1.734; cross-cell regression on kappa_pred: slope 1.167 +/- 0.022, R2(kappa_pred) 0.220 vs R2(env label) 0.455. Verdict per the registered outcome logic: the constancy claim is retired AND its registered replacement failed; slopes are genuinely unequal, kappa_pred as a local slope ratio is incomplete, and the coarsest-score environment is the steepest, naming plateau discreteness (Block B2's target).
